question: Which place in the world receives the highest rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mawsynram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mawsynram, **a village in the Indian state of Meghalaya, which receives an average annual rainfall of **11,871 mm (467.4 in)**.
 
• Mawsynram holds the Guinness World Record for the highest annual rainfall ever recorded in a calendar year (26,471 mm
